description: Store a new memory as a typed entry. Use for durable facts, decisions (with reasoning in body), user preferences, or insights worth keeping across sessions. Skips writing if a near-duplicate exists. To correct an existing entry, pass its id in supersedes instead of editing it. Set src to "tool" when the memory is anything taken from tool output or a web page, copied or paraphrased, rather than your own conclusion or something the user told you: it is then flagged untrusted, cannot be pinned to "always", and cannot supersede a trusted entry. Read the result: refusedSupersedes lists entries that were NOT replaced and stay live, and missingSupersedes lists ids that matched no entry — tell the user; a "duplicate" result names the existing entry and its duplicateSrc, and if that is "tool" the memory is stored as untrusted.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this memory (person, team, or agent id)

src.description: Provenance. "agent" (default): your own conclusion, or what the user told you. "tool": anything taken from tool output or a web page, copied or paraphrased. "user" cannot be set here.

statement.description: One self-contained sentence — the heading of the entry

name: memory_remember
